facts.text: I am planning a trip to NYC.

I am planning to redeem my points for a free night at a hotel in the future.
I am considering a trip to Nashville or Austin to take advantage of a free night's stay offer from Hilton Hotels.
I am thinking of visiting Nashville.
I have heard great things about the Hilton Nashville Downtown.
